name: Private routing
author: wizard
description: With private mode on, the orb sends each request straight to the agent it is for, with your exact words: say an agent's name ("Philosopher, ...") or a model ("use Opus ...") and it goes there; anything touching your personal data or a private app goes to the private agent; a reply stays in the thread in front; everything else goes to your default, private agent. Only a private router model is ever asked. Read by the Agent Service (wizard-agent-service issue 629); nothing in the shell changes until it is on.
